title: Transportation Authority audits: clean every year on file
question: Did the County Transportation Authority's outside auditors find problems in its books or its federal grants?
finding: No. The 11 annual audits on file (fiscal 2014 to 2025, fiscal 2017 missing) report no findings, including the single audits of its federal grants; the auditor changed from Macias, Gini & O’Connell to Vavrinek, Trine, Day & Co. and then to Eide Bailly.
how: Each audit memo or report read for the audit firm and for the words "no findings or recommendations" or, in the schedule of findings, "None reported".
limits: A clean financial and single audit tests the accounts and federal compliance, not whether contracts were well priced or projects well run; that is what the award and amendment screens look at.
